post.originalText:
Prompt share 🖤
Going Down To Die
A soul reaches the black river at the end of everything. Charon is waiting, the last ember of life is fading, and the coin for passage is already in hand.

This one is about grief, exhaustion, mortality, and finally letting go.

Feel free to use the prompt, make it your own, and show me what you create. I’d love to see everyone’s interpretation.

Prompt by Novasynthetica 🩸

#AIArt #DarkFantasy #GothicArt #PromptShare #FantasyArt
